definitions.explanation: Hair that is curly or wavy by nature rather than from a perm. Literally "natural perm"; often shortened to {天|てん}パ in casual speech.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{天然|てんねん}パーマだ。

examples.english: My hair is naturally curly, so it frizzes up on rainy days.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→頃：32850_koro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{天然|てんねん}パーマ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{嫌|いや}→嫌：10232_iya⟧だった⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{気|き}に{入|い}っている→気に入る：02047_kiniiru⟧。
examples.english: I hated my natural curls as a child, but now I like them.

notes:
USAGE:
Casual speech prefers the short form {天|てん}パ: {天|てん}パだ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧ (my hair is naturally curly, so mornings are a struggle). The opposite, naturally straight hair, is ⟦ストレート→ストレート：11630_sutoreeto⟧ or {直毛|ちょくもう}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {天然|てんねん}パーマ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悩|なや}む→悩む：02380_nayamu⟧: to struggle with naturally curly hair
- ⟦{軽|かる}い→軽い：00785_karui⟧{天然|てんねん}パーマ: slightly wavy hair
- {縮毛矯正|しゅくもうきょうせい}: hair-straightening treatment

WATCH OUT:
⟦{天然|てんねん}→天然：03560_tennen⟧ alone, said of a person, means naturally airheaded or ditzy, not curly-haired.
